briefdescription.para: Focused tests for Training Module Phase 2 items:

listitem.para: Adapter version management with integrity verification (deployVersionEx / rollbackVersionEx)
Multi-domain support beyond German legal text (MEDICAL / FINANCIAL DomainType)
Adapter serving integration with LLM inference layer (ILLMRouter / setLLMRouter)

detaileddescription.para: All tests are CPU-only and require no GPU hardware.
